sources.title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model - GitHub
sources.snippet: openvla-v01-7b: An early model used during development, trained from the Prismatic siglip-224px VLM (singular SigLIP vision backbone, and a Vicuña v1.5 LLM). Trained on the same mixture of datasets as Octo, but for significantly fewer GPU hours than our final model (mixture details - see "Open-X Magic Soup").

sources.title: IntentVLA: Short-Horizon Intent Modeling for Aliased Robot Manipulation
sources.snippet: The fused context and an appended history-evidence token form a short-horizon in-tent representation that conditions a standard DiT-based flow-matching action head.
